description: Rothco’s Fast Access Tactical Trauma Kit is your go-to solution for emergency preparedness, packed with over 80 essential first aid supplies in a durable and versatile Tactical Convertipack. The medical kit is designed for fast accessibility, allowing you to carry it as a waist pack, sling bag, or front pack, depending on your needs. With multiple compartments, including a large main compartment with an interior mesh pocket, 2 zippered side pouches, and a zippered front pouch with 3 interior pockets, it offers organized storage for all your first aid essentials. The emergency kit also includes MOLLE compatibility and 4 d-rings, making it easy to attach to other tactical gear. Built from heavyweight polyester, this trauma kit is both durable and adaptable. It also features an adjustable/removable shoulder strap for customized comfort. Please note this item has Hazmat restrictions and cannot be shipped via air freight. Other restrictions may apply.
